summary:
I read the whole of CMakeLists.txt (1137 lines), the 13 cmake/*.cmake modules, .gitignore, tools/css_to_gtk.py and packaging/README.md. The design follows DECISIONS.md: Windows only, no if(WIN32) branches, RadioS.exe and Python 3.14.8. Every main claim was checked with probes in the scratchpad against the installed MSYS2 UCRT64 (gcc 16.2, CMake 4.4.4, Ninja 1.13, GLib 2.90, GTK 3.24.52, FFmpeg 9.0.2). Nothing in the project was modified.

The Linux-only parts are the libpulse/alsa/xtst/x11 pkg-config checks, 64 GDK_BACKEND=x11 entries across 111 tests, WORKING_DIRECTORY /tmp (3 tests), PYTHONPATH joined with ':' (2 tests), -Wl,--as-needed, a test that compiles C at run time with `cc` and libpulse, and runners that need Xvfb, pactl/parec or a private Pulse daemon. Configure fails today because libpulse.pc and alsa.pc do not exist in MSYS2.

Measured hazards:
- GDK_BACKEND=x11 makes gtk_init_check fail, so 31 tests silently skip and 80 fail.
- GLib `-p /stale/case` runs zero tests and exits 0 (false pass); the MIDI hotplug case list is already stale.
- css_to_gtk.py crashes under the cp1254 locale encoding; `-X utf8` fixes it. Ninja handles the Turkish tasarrım path correctly.
- find_package(Python3) picks the registry's 3.15 unless pinned.
- mingw's binmode.o is an empty stub, so a project object must set `_fmode`.
- Manifests must use the `SMI` namespaces; the `SM` form is silently ignored.
- GNU ld `--wrap` does not intercept dllimport'ed GLib calls. The fix is `--wrap=__imp_<sym>` plus a function pointer; only test_header_ui (`g_get_real_time`) is affected.
- `--gc-sections` on PE cannot hide undefined references.

Recommended design:
- CMakePresets.json pins every tool; a toolchain module adds guards and the global defines `_FILE_OFFSET_BITS=64 _WIN32_WINNT/WINVER=0x0A00 UNICODE _UNICODE NOMINMAX GLIB_VERSION_MIN_REQUIRED=2_66`. `__USE_MINGW_ANSI_STDIO` is shown not to be needed. `-Werror` stays, limited to C.
- One deferred finalize step adds to every executable a UTF-8/PerMonitorV2 manifest, icon and version info, the binary `_fmode` object, the 8 MiB stack, and a WER/abort dialog guard for tests. `radios` gets `-mwindows` and a PDB via `-gcodeview --pdb`; the PE output is reproducible.
- CTest gets a global PATH, TZDIR, UTF-8 Python, `RADIOS_AUDIO_SERVER=null:` (except `hardware` tests), timeouts ×2, and a TAP `1..0` failure regex.
- The runtime and installer come from install() components plus GET_RUNTIME_DEPENDENCIES, an in-use-safe sync into runtime\, and a per-user NSIS installer that keeps data and config.

Licensing needs a lead decision: MSYS2 FFmpeg is GPLv3 and pulls 127 DLLs / 177 MB (including vulkan-1.dll). A minimal LGPL audio-only FFmpeg is recommended.
key_decisions: Windows-only CMake (D1): delete PULSE/ALSA/XTST/X11 pkg checks and links; hard FATAL_ERROR unless WIN32+MINGW+x64; toolchain check refuses non-MSYS2 gcc (C:\MinGW is on PATH) and non-UCRT; warn on non-ASCII/long build paths.
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.25...4.4); project(RadioS VERSION 0.19.0 LANGUAGES C RC) keeping the literal form parsed by radios_package.py.

CMakePresets.json v6 with presets windows-debug (build/), windows-debug-gui, windows-release (build/release), windows-release-tests, plus build presets windows-runtime and windows-installer and a workflow; all tool paths pinned to C:/msys64/ucrt64; PKG_CONFIG_LIBDIR isolated.

Global defines _FILE_OFFSET_BITS=64 _WIN32_WINNT=0x0A00 WINVER=0x0A00 UNICODE _UNICODE NOMINMAX GLIB_VERSION_MIN_REQUIRED=GLIB_VERSION_2_66; __USE_MINGW_ANSI_STDIO NOT defined (UCRT gives gnu_printf checking and C99 formats; verified).

Keep -std=c11 -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Werror, limited to C via generator expressions so windres never sees them. Release builds add -gcodeview, -fstack-protector-strong, -D_FORTIFY_SOURCE=2, -ffile-prefix-map and --no-insert-timestamp (reproducible output); radios also links with -Wl,--pdb=RadioS.pdb for minidump symbols.

One deferred finalize step (cmake_language(DEFER)) covers every executable, so the ~145 add_executable calls stay untouched: manifest (SMI namespaces: activeCodePage UTF-8, PerMonitorV2, longPathAware, asInvoker, Win10/11, ComCtl6), icon and VERSIONINFO (rc with #pragma code_page(65001)), crt_binmode.c (_fmode=_O_BINARY), LINKER:--stack,8388608 and, for tests, a WER/abort-suppressing constructor object. Only radios gets OUTPUT_NAME RadioS + WIN32_EXECUTABLE.

--wrap helper radios_wrap(target syms... DLLIMPORT syms...): dllimport'ed GLib/GIO/json-glib/cairo/curl functions need --wrap=__imp_<sym> + RADIOS_WRAP_DLLIMPORT pointer; GTK and radios_* symbols work as on ELF; never use LTO with --wrap.

Python: build-time generator uses pinned MSYS2 python with -X utf8 -B -I (registry lookup disabled); all CTest Python commands use <root>\runtime\python\python.exe -X utf8 -B -s; css_to_gtk.py reads/writes encoding=utf-8, newline='\n'.

CTest global env via ENVIRONMENT_MODIFICATION: PATH prepend MSYS2 bin (custom FFmpeg first if set), PYTHONUTF8/PYTHONIOENCODING/PYTHONNOUSERSITE, TZDIR=runtime/share/zoneinfo, unset GDK_BACKEND/DISPLAY/WAYLAND_DISPLAY/RADIOS_SDBASE_TOKEN, RADIOS_AUDIO_SERVER=null: except label hardware, TIMEOUT x2, FAIL_REGULAR_EXPRESSION for TAP '1..0'; GLib case names validated at configure time.

Mechanical test edits: remove 64 GDK_BACKEND=x11 and NO_AT_BRIDGE, /tmp -> build/test-cwd, PYTHONPATH via path_list_prepend, drop --as-needed and stale RADIOS_AUDIO_NULL, replace test_pulse_hotplug, add audio/platform tests, CMake target radios_automation_e2e instead of compiling with cc at test time; labels gui/audio/service/hardware, RESOURCE_LOCK desktop_input, RUN_SERIAL for soak/recovery/stress.

Static libraries stay static (needed for --wrap); new radios_platform static lib (platform.c, platform_win32.c, platform_tz.c) PUBLIC under radios_core; explicit Win32 libs per target (advapi32 ntdll dbghelp shell32 ole32 user32 | ole32 uuid avrt winmm mmdevapi propsys ksuser version shlwapi advapi32 | winmm cfgmgr32); no libaudioses exists, WASAPI GUIDs need one initguid.h TU.
Configure-time source coverage guard: every src/**/*.c must belong to a target (5 new port files currently orphaned).

Runtime prefix (D4): install components runtime/python/application -> stage -> tools/radios_sync_runtime.py with all-or-nothing in-use check into <root>\runtime (preserving runtime\python); DLL closure via file(GET_RUNTIME_DEPENDENCIES) with CMP0207 NEW; regenerate loaders.cache, gschemas.compiled, icon caches; ship tr .mo, fonts.conf, ca-bundle, zoneinfo, gspawn helpers.

Installer: hand-written NSIS 3.13 (Target amd64-unicode, Unicode, Turkish MUI2), per-user %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\RadioS, stops SDBASE service before upgrade, never installs/removes data\ or user config, per-user ARP entry; portable deterministic zip produced by a Windows-ported radios_package.py; CPack not used.
FFmpeg: recommend a minimal LGPL audio-only FFmpeg via RADIOS_FFMPEG_PREFIX for shipping (MSYS2 build is GPLv3, 127 DLLs/177 MB incl. vulkan-1.dll); lead decision required.
risks: GUI tests now run on the real desktop (no Xvfb): focus stealing, operator disruption on a broadcast PC, DPI-dependent geometry, session 0/locked screen; must return 77 without an interactive desktop and never run on the production PC.

False passes: stale GLib -p names run 0 tests with exit 0 (MIDI hotplug list already stale); leftover GDK_BACKEND=x11 silently skips 31 tests and fails 80; mitigated by fail regex, case validation and GDK_BACKEND unset.
MSYS2 is rolling: pacman -Syu can change GCC/GLib/FFmpeg ABI or add warnings that break -Werror; record package versions and freeze the release toolchain.
Licensing: bundling MSYS2 FFmpeg (GPLv3, x264/x265...) subjects the distribution to GPLv3 and bloats the package to ~180 MB DLLs incl. vulkan-1.dll.
DLL hijacking/foreign runtimes from C:\MinGW\bin on PATH (libwinpthread, libgcc_s, libstdc++) for build-tree tests; relies on PATH prepend and app-dir DLL bundling.
In-use files: staging or upgrading while RadioS.exe or the long-lived SDBASE python service runs fails on locked images; partial runtime if not pre-checked.
Long-path policy is off on the target machine and binutils/windres/ar are not UTF-8 aware; deep or non-ASCII build/install paths break builds and runners.
No ASan with MinGW GCC (only UBSan trap mode); the Linux sanitizer acceptance cannot be reproduced 1:1.
Defender first-launch scanning (9.2 s measured vs 0.05 s warm) and slower process/GTK start-up can push 20-30 s test timeouts over the limit after a rebuild.
Parallel porting drift: new source files (currently 5 src + 2 tests) not added to targets; per-test RADIOS_AUDIO_SERVER ENVIRONMENT values are overridden by the global null: unless labelled hardware.
install-time scripts depend on MSYS2 tools (objdump, glib-compile-schemas, gtk-update-icon-cache, gdk-pixbuf-query-loaders); packaging machine must match the MSYS2 snapshot.
Task text said Python 3.13; the staged and verified runtime is 3.14.8 (PLATFORM_FACTS) — hashes pinned in CMake to keep it explicit.
cross_area_dependencies: audio-backend/audio-routing: final radios_audio source list replacing pulse_backend.c (currently wasapi_backend.c, wasapi_device.c, planned null_provider.c), channel_input.c/patchbay.c without pulse headers, exactly one initguid.h TU, RADIOS_AUDIO_SERVER 'null:' semantics for the global test env, new tests test_audio_backend_hotplug/test_null_provider/test_wasapi_smoke (LABELS hardware)/test_wasapi_backend, runners rewritten from pactl/parec/Pulse daemon to the null provider.
midi: test_midi links winmm; test_midi_hotplug case names must be registered via radios_add_glib_cases (CMake list currently contains the removed ui-slow-sequencer); no --as-needed.

platform (core-posix-files): radios_platform sources, idempotent radios_platform_init() (build forces binary _fmode before main as well), radios_time_zone_directory() honouring TZDIR, radios_platform_test_symlink for tests, POSIX call sites in src/tests ported (list in spec §13 P9/P10).

ui-platform-c: main.c without glib-unix.h/signals, window.c without Fc* (then FONTCONFIG pkg check removed), content_scale_test_input.h SendInput branch, assets/icons/radios.ico, gtk-settings.ini content, verify manifest PerMonitorV2 vs GDK scaling at 125/150/175 %.

tests/test-infra: keep runner file names but rewrite bodies (Xvfb -> current desktop with 77 when no interactive desktop; pactl -> null provider); run_automation_stress.py takes --driver $<TARGET_FILE:radios_automation_e2e>; Python tests use D6 shims; tests/test_header_ui.c adds RADIOS_WRAP_DLLIMPORT(gint64, g_get_real_time, (void)).

tools/launchers: run-radios.cmd/run-database.cmd (CRLF, --project-root "%~dp0."), radios_launch.py builds with cmake --build --preset windows-runtime and runs runtime\bin\RadioS.exe, radios_sdk.py/run-radios-sdk.sh deleted, radios_package.py ported (PE checks, bundled DLL manifest, deterministic zip, Windows allow-lists, stage-manifest subcommand producing files.nsh).
config/core: config/radios.example.ini python_command = python3 is not a valid Windows path under the D4 fail-closed rule; shipped example must use empty/bundled interpreter semantics.
network (curl): set CURLSSLOPT_NATIVE_CA; installer still ships etc\ssl\certs\ca-bundle.crt.
lead: decide FFmpeg strategy (minimal LGPL audio-only build via RADIOS_FFMPEG_PREFIX vs GPLv3 compliance) and code-signing certificate.
platform_api_needs: void radios_platform_init(void) — idempotent, callable from any test/tool main; must tolerate _fmode already set to _O_BINARY by src/app/crt_binmode.c (linked into every exe) and keep calling _set_fmode(_O_BINARY) harmlessly.

const gchar *radios_time_zone_directory(void) — must prefer non-empty $TZDIR (CTest sets TZDIR=<root>/runtime/share/zoneinfo so tests use the same tzdata 2026.5 as the SDBASE service instead of MSYS2's 2026e).

gint radios_platform_test_symlink(const gchar *target, const gchar *link_path, gboolean directory, GError **error) — used by the 13 test files that call symlink(); returns -1 + G_IO_ERROR_NOT_SUPPORTED when unprivileged so tests can g_test_skip.
gssize radios_fd_pread(gint fd, gpointer buffer, gsize count, gint64 offset) — replaces pread in ~29 test files reading capture files (opened O_RDONLY|O_BINARY, share-delete).

Test-support macro (tests/radios_test_wrap.h, not platform.h): #define RADIOS_WRAP_DLLIMPORT(ret, name, params) ret (*__wrap___imp_##name) params = __wrap_##name — paired with CMake radios_wrap(<target> DLLIMPORT <sym>).

Python tools shim (tools/_platform.py) for tools/radios_package.py: open_nofollow(path) / regular-file check without O_NOFOLLOW, O_DIRECTORY or dir_fd; safe O_* flags with O_BINARY; flock via LockFileEx for default-binary.lock.

Build-time script tools/radios_sync_runtime.py needs no platform layer: stdlib only, in-use detection via os.open(path, os.O_RDWR | os.O_BINARY) raising PermissionError (WinError 32) on mapped images, per-file os.replace.
